objective: quantified shadow peak-shaving of the DERIVED real site load (P_load = grid + battery), retrospective backcast

sign_convention.grid: deye/ac/total_grid_power (sensor 7): positive = import from the grid.
sign_convention.battery: deye/battery/power (sensor 17): positive = discharge, negative = charge (verified: 3oh read -78 W while charging).
sign_convention.load: P_load = P_grid + P_batt, e.g. import 540 + battery -78 (charging) = 462 W real load.

assumptions.derived_load: The inflexible load is the DERIVED site load P_load = grid + battery, written to the site-load sensor, NOT the behind-meter net grid; scheduling against the raw net grid is circular and near-trivial (see shadow-g2.md).
assumptions.inflexible_wiring: flex_context inflexible-consumption is injected at runtime as [{sensor: site_load_sensor_id}]; run seed-site-load-sensor.py, then set site_load_sensor_id here.
assumptions.window: Retrospective backcast: end = floor(now), start = the continuous t2t run start within the horizon; the window grows to 24 h as data accumulates.
assumptions.perfect_hindsight: The shadow knows the whole window's load, so the reported peak reduction is a potential upper bound, not what a real-time EMS without a forecast could guarantee.
assumptions.capacity: 18 kWh is nameplate/calc, NOT measured; 19.7 kWh kept as a sensitivity value; SOH unknown.
assumptions.soc_at_start: Fixed 50% is an explicit assumption; there is no trustworthy live SOC (deye/battery/soc is forbidden, and the two strings diverge 53/24%).
assumptions.soc_band: 10-100% SOC band is a modelling choice; the hard voltage window 44-57 V is never widened.
assumptions.efficiency: 95%/95% charging/discharging is a declared round-trip efficiency, not a measurement.
assumptions.prices: Flat 50 EUR/MWh consumption=production is an internal nudge, not a tariff; the round-trip loss keeps the battery idle unless the peak price forces action.
assumptions.peak: site-peak-consumption 0.3 kW baseline and 120 EUR/MW price are an internal peak-shaving nudge, not a measured or contracted limit.
assumptions.prerequisite: Needs CONTINUOUS ingestion (labems-t2t) so the derivation inputs cover the window; min_input_coverage gates --commit against any gap (see shadow-g2.md).
